(Representative Image: Magnific) The National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS) has released the admit card for the Foreign Medical Graduate Examination (FMGE) October 2026 session. Candidates who have registered for the FMGE 2026 exam can now download their FMGE October 2026 admit cards from the official website, natboard.edu.in, using their login credentials.
 FMGE 2026: Sample Papers | Preparation Tips |  Syllabus 
 The FMGE October 2026 examination is scheduled to be held on October 31. Candidates should download their FMGE October 2026 hall tickets before the examination and check the details thoroughly. The FMGE October 2026 hall ticket is mandatory for entry into the examination centre. The FMGE October 2026 city slip was released on October 20.

 FMGE October 2026 admit card: How to download
 Candidates can follow these steps to download the admit card:
 Visit the official NBEMS website, natboard.edu.in.
 Go to the examinations section and select FMGE.
 Open the application link for the October 2026 session.
 Click on the login option.
 Enter the required user ID, password and captcha code.
 Open the FMGE October 2026 admit card link.
 Download the hall ticket and take a printout.
 Students should check their name, roll number, application ID, date of birth, photograph, examination centre address, and reporting time on the NBEMS FMGE admit card. If there is any error, they should report it to the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences.
 FMGE October 2026 exam date, pattern
 The FMGE October 2026 examination will be conducted in computer-based mode. The exam will have 300 multiple-choice questions, which are divided into two parts, each containing 150 questions. The total duration is five hours, with each session lasting two hours and 30 minutes.
The examination is a screening test for foreign medical graduates who want to get medical registration in India. Candidates should carry a printed copy of the FMGE October 2026 admit card and a valid photo identity proof to the examination centre. They should also follow the reporting time and other details mentioned on the hall ticket.
